signals.name: selectedFacility
signals.notes: Click a dot to choose that facility.

signals.name: hoverFacility
signals.notes: Remember the dot under the pointer.

signals.name: stateFilter
signals.notes: JavaScript sets this when you choose a state.

signals.name: industryFilter
signals.notes: JavaScript sets this when you choose an industry.

signals.name: searchName
signals.notes: JavaScript sets this when you search a facility name.

data.name: land
data.notes: GeoJSON gives the map background shape.

data.name: localBoundaries
data.notes: Use the same SA2 statistical area boundaries as V1 and V2. These are local statistical areas, not city council boundaries.

data.name: facilities
data.notes: NPI JSON gives the facility names and locations.

data.name: visibleFacilities
data.notes: Only the facilities matching the chosen state and industry become dots.

transform.notes: Change longitude and latitude into x and y positions on the map.

projections.name: australia
projections.notes: Fit the map to the Australia shape. Zoom and drag are added in dashboard-interactions.js.

marks.notes: Draw Australia as the pale map background.

marks.name: localBoundaryLines
marks.notes: Draw thin local area outlines behind the facility dots.

marks.name: facilityDots
marks.notes: Draw one small circle for each reporting facility. Hover or click changes its colour and shows details.

fill.signal: datum.Facility_ID === hoverFacility || datum.Facility_ID === selectedFacility || (searchName && indexof(lower(datum.Facility_Name), lower(searchName)) >= 0) ? '#D8891C' : '#7B3FB1'

description.signal: datum.Facility_Name + ', ' + datum.State + ', ' + datum.Industry + ', NPI 2024/2025 reporting facility'

tooltip.signal: {'Facility': datum.Facility_Name, 'State / territory': datum.State, 'Primary industry': datum.Industry, 'Reporting period': datum.Reporting_Period, 'Coverage': 'NPI reporting facility, not all manufacturers or certified facilities', 'Source ID': datum.Facility_ID}
